Complete all reading and language tasks on this page: Read and connect: a shared adventure. Clarice and Ethan wanted to enjoy the day together. Ethan explained that high rides made him dizzy. Clarice listened and suggested a different activity. She played a ring-toss game and won a teddy bear. Afterward, they bought cotton candy and took a walk. They had a good time because they respected each other’s preferences. although • because • after • so • while 1. _____ Ethan liked the park, he did not want to go on the high rides.
2. They changed their plan _____ the rides made him dizzy.
3. Clarice played the game _____ Ethan watched.
4. _____ Clarice won the bear, they bought cotton candy.
5. They respected each other’s preferences, _____ they both enjoyed the visit. Which word introduces a contrast, a reason, simultaneous actions, a sequence and a result? Use each in a new sentence about the episode.
